answer: A Proof of Agent network uses game-theoretic multi-agent auditing to defeat Sybil nodes: auditors cross-evaluate suspicious subgraphs, triggering stake slashing upon fraud. Topological cut verifications isolate clustered duplicates via bottleneck metrics, creating superlinear attacker cost scaling as O(N^1.5). For cryptographic seed generation, validators bind the sonnet corpus with a juniper root entropy pool and a lotus state transition hash.
